coverage.reason: Apply the existing Skills ledger theme to the Apply confirmation and unsaved-preset exit dialogs outside the profile container. The preset validator guards their existing controls, lifecycle, pricing, and allocation rules; production build validation covers the eagerly loaded stylesheet. Actual-game local browser QA checks desktop 1440x900, landscape 844x390 and 568x320, and portrait 390x844: readable palette, all eight skills, long names, scroll reachability, 44px controls, no horizontal overflow, Cancel/Escape/close/Apply outcomes, and native Save/Discard/Cancel return values. Styling is scoped to the two preset dialogs; no server or authority behavior changes, so no emulator suite is needed.
